description: Public Wi-Fi Locations is a dataset listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. This dataset is linked to the following visualization: Visualization - Public Wi-Fi Locations This dataset shows locations of public wi-fi provided at LCC buildings and properties across the city. It provides a map of these locations and breakdown in relation to the type of building i.e. library, museum etc. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under Building and Infrastructure, City and Governance. Its keywords are wi-fi, wifi, internet. The portal shows 62 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
